title: fix: require paid balance for OpenRouter models
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Marks the 12 remaining OpenRouter text models as paid-only: `mistral-small-3.2`, `mistral`, `gemma`, `gemma-4-31b`, `mimo-v2.5`, `mimo-v2.5-pro`, `llama-scout`, `qwen-large`, `qwen-vision`, `qwen-vision-pro`, `step-flash`, and `step-3.5-flash`.
- Leaves model IDs, providers, aliases, capabilities, pricing, multipliers, and routing unchanged.
- Adds a registry invariant requiring every OpenRouter model to be paid-only.
- Extends worker-level coverage to verify OpenRouter text models are hidden without pack balance, visible with pack balance, and rejected with HTTP 402 when called without paid balance.

Tests:
- Enter aliases: 274 passed
- Enter pricing and snapshot: 29 passed
- Gen permissions and billing: 12 passed
- Biome and `git diff --check` passed

gist.headline: The paid garden gate
gist.blurb: The remaining OpenRouter models now follow the same paid-balance rule as their neighbors. Twelve stray paths through the garden have been neatly fenced into the right lane.
gist.summary: Marked the 12 remaining OpenRouter text models—including mistral-small-3.2, Gemma, MiMo, Llama Scout, Qwen Vision, and Step Flash—as paid-only, with registry and worker tests enforcing pack-balance visibility and HTTP 402 access checks.
gist.impact: OpenRouter text models now consistently appear only for accounts with pack balance and return HTTP 402 when called without paid credit, while their IDs, aliases, pricing, capabilities, and routing remain unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden gate represents consistent paid-model access rules: Polli, wearing a tiny gardener tool belt, checks a glowing Pollen wallet before opening a vine-covered gate to a row of twelve labeled-but-small model seed packets. A CRT monitor robot holds a neat permissions checklist beside code-plants, emphasizing that the models themselves and their routes remain intact.
